{{Quote|I wonder if Selonians can be domesticated. Have a little girl back on Korriban. She's dying for a new pet.|Lord Kanno|<ref name="Ambient" />}}
The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Kanno]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] had a young '''daughter''' who lived on<ref name="Ambient" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Korriban">{{Holonet|planets|korriban|Korriban}}</ref> [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Galactic War]]. When Kanno was [[Imperial Garrison (Corellia)|garrisoned]] in the [[Battle of Corellia|war-torn]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]<ref name="Ambient" /> in [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">The events on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' take place toward the end of Act III, which occurs in [[3640 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR dates/3|here]]. Therefore, the ambient dialogue on Corellia must take place in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as well.</ref> he remarked interest in "domesticating" [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]]<ref name="Ambient" />&mdash;a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] whose local population was defending the [[City/Legends|city]] against [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial forces]]<ref name="Sewer Rats">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Sewer Rats|Corellia}}</ref>&mdash;for his [[Gender/Legends|daughter]], who desperately wanted a new pet.<ref name="Ambient" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kanno's daughter was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Ambient" />
